note: An exemption never yields PASS. It yields NOT_APPLICABLE, with the exemption cited.

exemptions.title: Pan masala exclusion
exemptions.explanation: The December 2025 amendment excludes pan masala from a specified provision with effect from 1 February 2026. Modelled as a dated exemption, not as a hard-coded product check.

exemptions.title: Wholesale packages
exemptions.explanation: Retail-price declarations are directed at retail packages. Wholesale packages are handled under their own provisions.

exemptions.title: Domestically manufactured packages
exemptions.explanation: Country-of-origin and importer declarations attach to imported packages.

exemptions.title: Medical devices follow their own character-size treatment
exemptions.explanation: Where the 2025 amendment directs the Medical Devices framework, the generic character-size rule is not the operative provision.

exemptions.title: Non e-commerce transactions
exemptions.explanation: Listing-level obligations attach to e-commerce transactions only.
